name: elements-workspace
description: ElementsPanel workspace — a fork of the MCSManager project

scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix core/common && npm run type-check --prefix core/panel && npm run type-check --prefix core/daemon && npm run type-check --prefix core/frontend
scripts.install: npm run install-dependents && npm run preview-build
scripts.install-dependents: cd core/daemon && npm install && cd ../panel && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.all: concurrently -n Daemon,Frontend,Panel -c cyan,magenta,green -p name "npm run dev --prefix core/daemon" "npm run dev --prefix core/frontend" "npm run dev --prefix core/panel"
scripts.build:npm: npm run build --prefix core/common && npm run build --prefix core/daemon && npm run build --prefix core/panel && npm run build-only --prefix core/frontend && node scripts/package-npm.mjs
scripts.preview-build: cd core/common && npm install && npm run build
